mcp:tool-listener.name: list-applications
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Lists the account-opening applications: ID, applied date, applicant, status (受付 / 口座開設 / 確認待ち / 承認待ち / 否認 / 追加確認) and the rules they tripped. Give status to list only that status.

mcp:tool-listener.name: get-application
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Returns one account-opening application in a single call: the applicant (age, occupation, income, experience, requested risk, planned first deposit), the rules it tripped with details, existing customers with the same family or given name (to spot duplicates), and watch-list entries whose name overlaps (with birth dates to tell people apart). The ID looks like OA-0003; "0003" or "3" is accepted too. Returns {"found": false} when there is no such application.

mcp:tool-listener.name: request-account-approval
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Sends the recommendation with the review memo to the approval inbox, where an employee decides (承認 opens the account, 否認 rejects it, 追加確認 asks the applicant for more). Returns {"status": "requested", "approvalId": ...}, or "already_pending" / "already_decided" / "not_found" / "failed" with the reason.
